Parameter.name: MOD SOURCE
Parameter.tooltip:
Selects the modulation source for both A and B channels:
  • LFO: Uses a single LFO to modulate pitch for both channels A and B. MOD DEPTH and LFO RATE are adjustable.
  • LFO Stereo: Similar to LFO, but PITCH channels A and B are modulated out of phase for a wider stereo effect.
  • +Envelope: Pitch modulation increases as input signal level increases.
  • -Envelope: Pitch modulation increases as input signal level decreases.

Parameter.name: ENV GAIN
Parameter.tooltip: Sets how strongly the envelope follower reacts to input dynamics. Disabled when MOD SOURCE is either LFO or LFO Stereo.

Parameter.name: X-FEEDBACK
Parameter.tooltip: Activate to feed the output of Delay A into Delay B and vice versa.

Parameter.name: RETRIGGER
Parameter.tooltip: When enabled, it resets the pattern to the first step when playing a new note or chord.

Parameter.tooltip: Reverses the phase polarity of the input signal. When STEREO LINK is set to ‘Unlinked’, this parameter affects only the left input channel.

Parameter.name: Ø ADJUST
Parameter.tooltip: Toggles the “Phase Adjust” parameters and sets the operating range of the PHASE SHIFT knob to either 90° or 180°. When STEREO LINK is set to ‘Unlinked’, this parameter affects only the left input channel.

Parameter.name: Ø CENTER
Parameter.tooltip: Selects whether the phase adjustment is applied to lower or higher frequencies. When STEREO LINK is set to ‘Unlinked’, this parameter affects only the left input channel.

Parameter.name: Ø SHIFT
Parameter.tooltip: Continuously varies the phase of the input signal. Its range is either 90° or 180°, depending on the PHASE ADJUST setting. When STEREO LINK is set to ‘Unlinked’, this parameter affects only the left input channel.

Parameter.name: STEREO LINK
Parameter.tooltip: Links or unlinks the ‘Phase Doctor’ input channels. When ‘Unlinked’, the phase of the left and right input channels can be controlled independently.

Parameter.name: Ø POLARITY R
Parameter.tooltip: Reverses the phase polarity of the input signal. This parameter affects only the right input channel.

Parameter.name: Ø ADJUST R
Parameter.tooltip: Toggles the “Phase Adjust” parameters and sets the operating range of the PHASE SHIFT knob to either 90° or 180°. This parameter affects only the right input channel.

Parameter.name: Ø CENTER R
Parameter.tooltip: Selects whether the phase adjustment is applied to lower or higher frequencies. This parameter affects only the right input channel.

Parameter.name: Ø SHIFT R
Parameter.tooltip: Continuously varies the phase of the input signal. Its range is either 90° or 180°, depending on the PHASE ADJUST setting. This parameter affects only the right input channel.

Toggles external control of the Minivoicer block via MIDI note messages. When enabled, the following parameters are disabled: QUANTIZE, V1 ACTIVE, V2 ACTIVE, ROOT, and MODE.

MIDI note messages perform best when both the device interface and the Cortex Control app are idle. You may experience slight delays if actions are being performed on the device or in the app while MIDI notes are being played.

Parameter.name: DRY LEVEL
Parameter.tooltip: Increase to blend in the direct input signal alongside the processed voices.

Parameter.name: UNISON LEVEL
Parameter.tooltip: Adjusts the level of the square wave generated from the direct input signal pitch. The UNISON is the core PLL signal and serves as the foundation for the MULTIPLIER and DIVIDER signals.

Parameter.name: MUL. LEVEL
Parameter.tooltip: Adjusts the volume of the MULTIPLIER signal, an octave-up signal created by increasing the frequency of the UNISON pitch.

Parameter.name: DIV. LEVEL
Parameter.tooltip: Adjusts the volume of the DIVIDER signal, created by reducing the frequency of the UNISON pitch, resulting in sub-octave square waves.

Parameter.name: MUL. SOURCE
Parameter.tooltip:
Selects the input source for the MULTIPLIER:
  • UNISON: Multiplies the UNISON original pitch.
  • -1, -2 OCTAVES: Multiplies the UNISON pitch one or two octaves below for heavier harmonic content.

Parameter.name: DIV. SOURCE
Parameter.tooltip:
Selects the input source for the DIVIDER:
  • UNISON: Divides the UNISON original pitch.
  • MULTIPLIER: Divides the MULTIPLIER signal.

Parameter.name: MULTIPLIER
Parameter.tooltip: Sets how many times faster the MULTIPLIER signal frequency is compared to the UNISON pitch. Higher values increase pitch (up to 8 times), resulting in brighter, more chaotic tones.

Parameter.name: DIVIDER
Parameter.tooltip: Sets how many times the UNISON pitch frequency is divided to generate the output (from 2 to 8 times). Higher values produce deeper, glitchier sub-octaves.

Parameter.name: RESPONSE
Parameter.tooltip: Controls how quickly the PLL reacts to changes in pitch. Lower values give a slower response, while higher values make the tracking faster.

Parameter.name: STABILITY
Parameter.tooltip: Adjusts the PLL’s internal balance between steady tracking and chaotic behavior. Higher values create smoother tones, while lower values increase unpredictability and artifacts.

Parameter.name: THRESHOLD
Parameter.tooltip:
Sets the sensitivity of the TRAILS GATE when enabled. Input below the set value will mute the MULTIPLIER and DIVIDER signal, helping suppress unwanted noise or pitch drops after note releases.
Also acts as a pitch tracking threshold, affecting how the UNISON signal responds to the direct input signal.

Parameter.name: TRAILS GATE
Parameter.tooltip: Toggles gating behavior upon note release. Enable to prevent "dive-bomb" effect or chaotic pitch drops when the note transients end.

Parameter.name: INSTRUMENT
Parameter.tooltip: Optimizes pitch tracking for Guitar or Bass.

Parameter.name: RESAMPLER
Parameter.tooltip: Sample Rate control. Lower values cause more aliasing and lo-fi artifacts.

Parameter.name: BIT DEPTH
Parameter.tooltip: Signal resolution control. Lower values introduce more distortion by reducing dynamic accuracy.

Parameter.name: SHAPE
Parameter.tooltip: Smooths transitions between quantization steps to reduce abrupt gating at low bit depths. Helps maintain a more natural sound.

Parameter.name: RESAMPLER
Parameter.tooltip: Sample Rate control. Lower values cause more aliasing and lo-fi artifacts.

Parameter.name: FREQ. MULTI
Parameter.tooltip: Multiplies the frequency value of the direct input signal by a selected amount (from 2 to 32 times).

Parameter.name: BIT DEPTH
Parameter.tooltip: Signal resolution control. Lower values introduce more distortion by reducing dynamic accuracy.

Parameter.name: SHAPE
Parameter.tooltip: Smooths transitions between quantization steps to reduce abrupt gating at low bit depths. Helps maintain a more natural sound.

Parameter.name: MODE
Parameter.tooltip:
Determines the Glitch mode:
  • SEQUENCE: Generates long, evolving note sequences.
  • PITCH DELAY: A classic delay-style mode with pitch modulation. Increasing the CHAOS knob introduces more aggressive feedback behavior.
  • INTERFERE: Functions like a repeater with automatic mix adjustment. At higher MIX values, it can blend into (or intentionally disrupt) your playing.
  • TEXTURIZER: Creates dense clouds of grains for rich, ambient textures.

Parameter.name: LOOP LENGTH
Parameter.tooltip: Sets the loop length, in tempo subdivisions, from which grains are extracted.

Parameter.name: READ POINT
Parameter.tooltip: Sets the time offset before grain playback. This parameter is only active in ‘Pitch Delay’ and ‘Texturizer’ modes. A value of '0' plays back grains immediately.

Parameter.name: PITCH AMT.
Parameter.tooltip: Sets the amount of random pitch shifting applied to the grains. Increase it to introduce wider pitch variation and more experimental textures.

Parameter.name: CHAOS
Parameter.tooltip: Increase it to randomize multiple parameters and create more chaotic, unpredictable results.

Parameter.name: MULTIPLIER
Parameter.tooltip: Sets the frequency ratio of the modulator relative to the input signal. Lower values divide the input frequency (/4, /3, /2), while higher values multiply it (x2, x3, x4). A value of x1 preserves the original frequency.

Parameter.name: OFFSET
Parameter.tooltip: Continuously offsets the Multiplier value, allowing fine adjustment between its fixed steps.

Model.name: Overlord Synth
Model.tm: From 'Archetype: Rabea®' by Neural DSP®

Parameter.name: SENSITIVITY
Parameter.tooltip: Sets how strongly the synth responds to your playing dynamics.

Parameter.name: ROOT
Parameter.tooltip: Determines the root note of the musical scale used by the arpeggiator. Select OFF to use the played note as the root.

Parameter.name: SLOPE
Parameter.tooltip: Sets the steepness of the filter slope in decibels per octave. Slope values increase in 6 dB increments. Higher values create a steeper slope.

Parameter.name: F.E. AMOUNT
Parameter.tooltip: Controls how strongly the filter responds to the instrument envelope. Positive values close the filter, while negative values open it.

Parameter.name: F.E. DCY/ATCK
Parameter.tooltip: Controls the filter envelope’s attack or decay. Turning the knob clockwise increases the attack time for a softer onset, while turning it counterclockwise shortens the decay, reducing sustain.

Parameter.name: F.E. SUSTAIN
Parameter.tooltip: Controls the sustain length of the filter envelope.

Parameter.name: MIDI CH.
Parameter.tooltip:
Sets the MIDI channel for external control of the Overlord Synth block via MIDI note messages. When a MIDI channel is selected, the following parameters are disabled: SENSITIVITY, GATE, SOURCE, and GLIDE.

MIDI note messages perform best when both the device interface and the Cortex Control app are idle. You may experience slight delays if actions are being performed on the device or in the app while MIDI notes are being played.
